title: When to burn tokens
text: Well, it's definitely work on staying under budget on tokens. Like, um, I mean, I, I think if, if there's a use for burning tokens, like if we have a five hour window that's about to, to collapse and we have plenty of uh, if we're way under pace, and we're, there's not much else in you know that we're planning for, then burning a bunch of tokens can be useful. And so you can just spawn a whole bunch of agents to kind of like test out whether uh, you can get better results or unique outcomes or whatever by by having a consensus of agents.
